name: Hyper Hyper Hook
summary:
# Natural Hook & Swing mechanic
Polished and easy to learn swing mechanics, giving you the true feel of freedom of movement. 
The true competitor, however, will be those who truly master their hooks!

# Customization
Chose your look from a library of free cosmetics with a ton of colors to chose from, or find a pack you love for a unique twist on your style!

# Social fun
Join a lobby with strangers, or create you own for you and your friends! Voice chat is included!
